messages:
maya: Heads up — overnight eval runs left ~1.2k sideloaded objects in s3://eval-artifacts-sideload with NO corresponding manifest entries. Not sure if this is a runner bug or transient S3 glitch. anyone seen this? :confused:

dan: saw ~30 keys yesterday but assumed cleanup. logs show manifest write failing with conditional check sometimes.

leo: paste from the runner log:

```
ERROR runner.upload: manifest write failed: ConditionalCheckFailedException
trace_id=abc123 run=2026-03-18T04:12Z
s3_keys_written=12 manifest_write_retry=0
```

arjun: that screams race between multipart sideload commit (S3) and manifest conditional write (Dynamo). If S3 commit wins and ddb write loses we get orphaned objects.

maya: CI alarms tripped this morning — `eval.artifacts.orphan_sideload_count` spiked. Paging the infra folks in a bit.

ci-bot: Job eval-runner-integration (#452) failed: artifact-index-spec tests. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/452

dan: quick mitigation idea: make the manifest write transactional (TransactWriteItems) so we get atomicity or fail before S3 commit, plus add retry+exponential backoff around the multipart commit. Also add a reconciler that imports orphaned keys back into manifests.

leo: repro steps we used locally:
1) run eval-runner with `--sideload`
2) simulate transient ddb ConditionalCheckFailed by throwing in `PutItem`
3) observe s3 parts committed but manifest missing

arjun: agreed on approach. Also need to make manifest writes idempotent by including `manifest_id` and version compare. That'll let us retry without creating duplicates.

sre-bot: Created incident INC-2026-34 to track orphaned sideload objects. Alert rule: orphan-sideload-count > 100 => page oncall.

maya: proposed rollout plan:
- hotfix reconciler lambda to backfill manifests for keys older than 24h (quick stopgap)
- patch runner to use TransactWrite + 3 retries for manifest commit (hotfix to staging)
- add unit + integration tests and CI gating for the new atomic path
- nightly reconciler to garbage-collect orphaned objects older than 7d (policy change)
- update docs and runbook

arjun: I'll own the runner patch.

dan: I'll build the reconciler lambda and add the GC policy change.

leo: I'll add the integration tests and the flaky repro to CI so we catch regressions.

maya: can we ship hotfix to staging today? need infra approval — @infra-team 

dan: created PR #738: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/738. Key change is using transactWrite to make manifest commit atomic. snippet:
```
await dynamo.transactWrite({
  TransactItems: [
    { Put: { TableName: 'manifests', Item: manifestItem, ConditionExpression: 'attribute_not_exists(pk) OR #v = :v', ExpressionAttributeNames: {'#v': 'version'}, ExpressionAttributeValues: {':v': manifestVersion}} },
    { Put: { TableName: 'sideload-metadata', Item: metaItem } }
  ]
})
```

maya: add feature flag `sideload_manifest_atomic` default ON for staging so infra can flip if anything weird happens.

ci-bot: CI results: unit tests 120 passed, integration 7/9 failed (known flaky). re-run queued.

leo: also adding a small reconciler test harness that will create 100 orphan keys and ensure reconciler backfills manifests correctly. That test will live in `integration/orphan_reconciler_test.go`.

sre-bot: FYI — we're going to enable the page rule on the alert after hotfix deploy to staging to verify noise level.

maya: timeline: patch + tests today, reconciler lambda tomorrow, staging deploy today evening, production deploy after 48h of stable staging metrics. I'll update the runbook and post PR links here once ready. :thumbsup:
